footer_mac: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. × clears it (it won't fire or fall back to the default); the switch turns it off. Every shortcut includes {mod}, so single keys are never taken over. Press {help} any time to see your shortcuts.
footer_other: Click a shortcut, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. × clears it (it won't fire or fall back to the default); the switch turns it off. Every shortcut includes {mod}, so single keys are never taken over. On Windows and Linux, Ctrl shortcuts override the same keys in the terminal (like Ctrl+K); you can change or turn them off here. Press {help} any time to see your shortcuts.
recording_label: {name}: press the new shortcut, Esc to cancel
terminal_footer: The terminal handles these keys itself. They can't be changed, and no other shortcut takes them.
title: Shortcuts
enable_all_hint: When off, no shortcut works. Each one's settings are kept
all_off_footer: All shortcuts are off. You can still run commands from the command palette.
unset_label: {name}: no shortcut, click to set one
taken: {chord} is used by "{label}". Replacing clears its shortcut
default_taken: The default {chord} is used by "{label}". Replacing clears its shortcut
